scope: Private bounded immutable public-proof artifact storage and explicit interrupted-write cleanup. Not a transition journal, live worker service, candidate recovery or performance qualification.

implementation.feature_gate: block-v2; Linux-only storage module. Existing optional libc dependency is enabled for research filesystem safeguards. No new dependency version, default proof/verification change, ABI symbol or production activation.
implementation.filesystem_contract: Dedicated private operator-owned directory, Linux/procfs, exclusive kernel lock, atomic hard-link publication and directory fsync. Persistent-storage durability depends on the underlying filesystem/device contract.
implementation.path_binding: Operations are anchored to an open directory descriptor. Final-component symlinks, unsafe ownership/modes, unexpected file kinds/names/links and replaced owner locks fail closed.
implementation.publication: Accept only existing VerifiedWallet/VerifiedNode tickets plus exact matching bytes. Write a create-new private temporary file; fsync file; atomically hard-link without replacement; fsync directory; unlink temporary name; fsync directory. Mid-publication errors poison the object.
implementation.inventory: Bounded canonical descriptors are untrusted metadata, never validity tickets or completed jobs.
implementation.recovery: Reopen under the exclusive lock, explicitly delete recognized pending-write names, preserve published orphans, and reverify loaded wallet/node bytes on CPU against external registry/chain/job expectations.

limits.publication_reservation: existing logical artifact bytes plus twice the new artifact length; two directory entry slots
limits.excluded_from_logical_byte_count: filesystem block rounding, metadata, zero-length owner-lock entry and future journal; aggregate physical scratch admission remains a service responsibility

implementation.trust_boundary: No isolation from a malicious same-uid process, kernel or filesystem. A returned stored identity is not a durable job completion.

expanded.ignored_explanation: Two pinned CPU fixture checks run explicitly afterward; the third is the subprocess helper invoked five times by its parent crash test.
checks: release CPU test build with block-v2-wide-lanes,stream

native: Exclusive ownership and reopening; creation never repurposes an existing path.
Exact kind/length/byte binding, non-overwriting idempotency and pre-write byte/entry admission.
Five injected error boundaries and five abrupt subprocess exits: after write, file fsync, hard-link publication, directory fsync and temporary cleanup.
Corrupt, missing and length-changed artifacts fail closed and are not overwritten.
Symlink/hard-link/mode/owner-lock/unknown-name rejection; descriptor Unicode, field canonicality and length bounds.
Open directory remains authoritative after original path replacement.
Recovery rejects oversized files and excessive entries/bytes; zero-length recognized pending writes are safely cleaned.
real_cpu: Existing independently pinned eight-wallet/root job-contract replay.
Store eight verified wallet artifacts and one CPU-verified root; close/reopen; CPU-reverify all wallets and derive the same expected semantic root job.
CPU-reverify the preserved recursive root against that job; reject wrong chain, swapped transaction order and mutated stored bytes.
Delete only the temporary store's wallet copies, then CPU-reverify its root without loading those copies. Independent source fixtures remain unchanged.

remaining: Durable transition journal and atomic current-attempt completion.
Graph reconstruction, fresh-session fencing, surviving-worker reconciliation and host eligibility rechecks before resuming dispatch.
Journal-owned reference/retention-aware artifact garbage collection; the store does not automatically delete published artifacts.
Real CPU/GPU worker adapters, physical aggregate resource enforcement and arrival-driven harness.
Storage-device/filesystem power-loss qualification; current fault tests cover process interruption, not physical power loss.
GPU performance work, full64 cold/complete post-seal targets, full transaction types, complete-tree security, host integration and explicit activation.
